- [USER] User requested album recommendations from The Tangent.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended albums by The Tangent:
  1) "Not as Good as the Book" (2008) - A concept album exploring the history of progressive rock.
  2) "Le Sacre du Travail" (2013) - Inspired by Stravinsky's "The Rite of Spring," exploring themes of work and labor.
  3) "A Spark in the Aether" (2015) - Showcases jazz and fusion elements.
  4) "Proxy" (2018) - Features original members and explores political and social themes.
  5) "Auto Reconnaissance" (2020) - Deals with grief, loss, and self-discovery.
